South Carolina’s most-circulated newspaper, _The Post and Courier_ of Charleston, has endorsed Gov.Gary Johnson for President.
Also on Sunday, November 6,_The Danville Register & Bee_ also endorsed Johnson.
Gary Johnson gives us a chance to tell the major parties that 2016 marks the end of business as usual in Washington and that the era of ever-expanding government is coming to an end.
